analyst_view.overall: Hajduk Split (13th, 6 pts) host Sint-Truiden (10th, 7 pts) with both still in range of the knockout places, so neither side has a reason to hold back. Poljud is closed to regular fans after UEFA punished fan misconduct at the Ajax game; about 8,000 invited children aged 8 to 13 will sit in the east stand, and Sint-Truiden bought 195 tickets for around 250 travelling supporters. Hajduk, top of the HNL after a 2-1 win at Lokomotiva, are still without centre-back Dennis Hadzikadunic (counted), Pajaziti, Ivusic and Brajkovic, while winger Soticek and Bamba were rested as a precaution at the weekend; coach Gonzalo Garcia said there was no cause for concern. Sint-Truiden drew 2-2 at Charleroi under new coach Jonas De Roeck and report no new injuries. Italian referee Matteo Marchetti is named, and the numbers already trim cards about 7% for his record.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.1 goals, already adding about 6% to Sint-Truiden's goals for Hadzikadunic's absence. Both sides' recent scoring, Hajduk's league run and Sint-Truiden's lively start under De Roeck, is in the momentum adjustment, and Soticek's and Bamba's knocks look precautionary, so I stay at 3.1.

corners.text: The numbers say 8.4 corners, with Hajduk's recent corner count nudged up and Sint-Truiden's down by momentum. The near-empty stadium and the new Sint-Truiden coach don't point clearly to more or fewer corners, so I stay at 8.4.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.4 cards, already trimmed for referee Marchetti's low card record (-7%) and both sides' recent counts. I lean a little lower, to about 3.3: with Poljud closed to regular fans, only invited children in the stands and a couple of hundred away supporters, there is far less crowd pressure on players and referee, which the numbers can't see.

shots.text: The numbers say 25.9 shots. Sint-Truiden's busy attacking and Hajduk's tight recent defending are both in the momentum adjustment (Sint-Truiden -6% given who they face), and the team news has no new absence that changes shot volume, so I stay at 25.9.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.0 shots on target, already trimmed for Hajduk conceding few on target lately (Sint-Truiden -7%). Hadzikadunic's absence is already counted on the goals side and nothing else in the news changes how often either side tests the goalkeeper, so I stay at 9.0.
